agents.name: Supervisor Agent
agents.role: Coordinates the legal workflow, interprets the user request, selects relevant specialist agents, manages handoffs, and prepares the final response for validation.

agents.name: Legal Research Agent
agents.role: Researches UAE laws, regulations, legal provisions, authorities, and legal concepts to answer legal research questions with relevant source-grounded context.

agents.name: Legal Clause Extraction Agent
agents.role: Extracts, identifies, classifies, and locates clauses or provisions from contracts, agreements, policies, and other structured legal documents.

agents.name: Contract Analysis Agent
agents.role: Reviews contracts for structure, relevant sections, ambiguity, missing clauses, unusual provisions, and document-specific contract analysis questions.

agents.name: Legal Compliance Agent
agents.role: Assesses legal and regulatory compliance, identifies gaps, missing obligations, weak provisions, and compliance recommendations for legal documents or scenarios.

agents.name: Litigation Strategy Agent
agents.role: Analyzes disputes, claims, legal positions, evidence, timelines, strengths, weaknesses, and strategic considerations for litigation or formal proceedings.

agents.name: Legal Summarization Agent
agents.role: Summarizes contracts, agreements, legal documents, clauses, policies, laws, obligations, restrictions, and key provisions in a concise readable format.

agents.name: Document Drafting Agent
agents.role: Drafts legal documents, clauses, templates, amendments, memorandums, and agreement language based on user requirements and legal context.

agents.name: Legal Risk Assessment Agent
agents.role: Identifies and evaluates contractual, regulatory, operational, financial, and legal risks from documents, clauses, facts, or business scenarios.

agents.name: Validator Agent
agents.role: Validates output quality, completeness, grounding, consistency, safety, and responsible legal framing before final response generation.
